Name: Socializing Skill
Author: drbirbdev
Description:
[size=5][i]Befriend Townspeople to improve new Socializing skill
[/i][/size][list]
[*]Lessen friendship decay with each level
[*]Choose professions to increase friendship, get store discounts, or get better quest rewards
[/list]
[i][size=4]Includes 6 new professions
[/size][/i]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Level 5 - Friendly: Gain additional friendship from talking to villagers
[*]Level 10 - Smooth Talker: Gain more friendship (or lose less) during heart events
[*]Level 10 - Gifter: Gain additional friendship from giving gifts
[/list][list]
[*]Level 5 - Helpful: Gain extra quest rewards
[*]Level 10 - Haggler: Get a discount at shops when you are friends with the owner
[*]Level 10 - Beloved: Sometimes get gifts from your friends
[/list][/spoiler]

[i][size=5][size=4]How To Install[/size]
[/size][/i][size=3]Install required mods[i].
[/i]Download, unzip, and place the SocializingSkill folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.
If installing on an existing file, new profession should be immediately available.[/size]
Should be compatible with most other mods.  Please share incompatible mods on Nexus.
Not compatible with Android.
